column3: MT 63:19. “If you tore” is rendered “Oh, that You wouldst rend.”
MT 64:4. “One who rejoices and does righteousness” is rendered “him who rejoices in doing righteousness,” and NASB adds “for” and “continued.”
MT 64:5. “Garment of menstruation” is rendered “a filthy garment.”
MT 64:6. “Melted us in the hand of” is rendered “delivered us into the power of.”
MT 64:7. NASB supplies “potter” for “the one who formed us.”
